description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different datasets. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names – blank, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni – listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are two bars presented side-by-side: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. For the blank dataset, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 50%, while the MMAR bar reaches approximately 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 60%, and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 35%. Finally, for Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 65%, and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 55%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing one MMAU bar and one MMAR bar. No bars are visually emphasized, and the datasets are sorted alphabetically.
